exposure: Maternal chronic kidney replacement therapy (dialysis or transplant)
Transplanted women with serum creatinine <= 120 mumol/l
Preterm babies of dialyzed and transplanted mothers
cohort: 248 births to Australian women receiving chronic kidney replacement therapy (KRT) between 1991-2013, compared with 2,948,084 births in the non-KRT cohort
finding: Maternal dialysis and transplantation, even with good preconception allograft function, were associated with increased risks of adverse perinatal outcomes, particularly for preterm babies.
